title: Offset Announces ‘She Ain’t Mine’ Single to Launch New Solo Era: ‘Just Something I Need’
summary: Quavo also revealed a Migos reunion is in the works.
contentText:
Offset has launched a new solo era. The Atlanta rapper announced Tuesday (Sept. 15) that his “She Ain’t Mine” single is set to arrive on Friday (Sept. 18).

Set shared a video teaser on Monday and then followed up with the cover art, which finds him in a body of water hugging an unidentified woman. “JUST SOMETHING I NEED,” he added in the caption.

Internet detectives hopped into Offset’s comments trying to figure out who the woman in the artwork was, while some lent guesses like Saweetie or Cardi B rival BIA.

An accompanying teaser clip featured Set taking a boat trip on a gloomy day and enjoying some yacht time with various women at sea. “She Ain’t Mine” figures to be the lead single heading into the Migos rapper’s next solo project.

Offset’s last album, Kiari , arrived in September 2025 and debuted at No. 16 on the Billboard 200. Following the solo endeavor, fans can expect Set and Quavo to reunite for a final Migos album and tour together.

Huncho sat down with V-103’s DJ Greg Street  earlier in September, where he opened up about plans for the Migos. The album will feature posthumous vocals from groupmate Takeoff, who was killed in a shooting in November 2022.

“We coming back. We’re going to do it one more time,” Quavo said. “Long live the Rocket … There’s more. We going to tour. We going to do it right.”

Culture III served as the Migos’ most recent album, which was released in 2021 and debuted at No. 2 on the  Billboard 200 . Ahead of the reunion, Quavo is set to drop his own solo album with Qrömelife , which will arrive on Oct. 2.
